description: Approve a pending shipper deployment pairing by user_code. Ownership-bound: caller's client_id must match deployment.initiating_client_id OR the caller must be operator_equivalent per vault. Constant-time user_code comparison. Transitions deployment pending → approved (clears user_code in same write). Part of M5 shipper bootstrap pairing flow.
